wrist-watch.case: The outer case protects the tiny moving parts. The clear cover lets you read the time.
wrist-watch.barrel: Turning the winding knob tightens a spring. As it unwinds, it powers the watch.
wrist-watch.train: Small toothed wheels pass movement from the spring towards the hands.
wrist-watch.hands: These small wheels make the hour hand turn more slowly than the minute hand.
wrist-watch.escapement: This part lets the wheels move forward a tiny step at a time.
wrist-watch.balance: A small wheel rocks back and forth against a spring, helping the watch keep time.
wrist-watch.crown: Pull or turn this knob to set the time or wind the watch.
wrist-watch.jewels: Tiny hard, smooth supports help the spinning ends move with little rubbing.
wrist-watch.bridges: These supports hold the wheels in the right places so their teeth meet.
wrist-watch.regulator: This adjustment helps make the watch tick a little faster or slower.

car-engine.block: This strong metal body holds the spaces where the moving pistons slide.
car-engine.crank: This bent shaft changes the pistons' up-and-down movement into turning movement.
car-engine.piston: Hot gas pushes this sliding part down. Its movement helps turn the engine.
car-engine.head: This top cover closes each piston space and holds the parts that let gas in and out.
car-engine.rod: This strong bar joins a sliding piston to the turning shaft.
car-engine.intake: This small gate opens to let fresh air and fuel into the engine.
car-engine.exhaust: This small gate opens to let burned gas leave the engine.
car-engine.camshaft: This turning shaft opens the gas gates at the right moments.
car-engine.spark: A spark starts the burning of the fuel-and-air mixture.
car-engine.cooling: Oil helps moving parts slide, while the cooling system carries away extra heat.

turbofan.inlet: This opening guides air into the engine. The outer case surrounds the fan.
turbofan.fan: This large fan pushes air backwards. Much of the air goes around the engine's centre.
turbofan.compressor: Rows of blades squeeze the air before it reaches the burning section.
turbofan.combustor: Fuel burns with the squeezed air, making the gas much hotter.
turbofan.hpt: Hot gas turns these blades, which drive the part that squeezes the air.
turbofan.lpt: Another set of blades takes energy from the gas to turn the big front fan.
turbofan.bypass: This space lets some air go around the hot centre of the engine.
turbofan.shaft: Turning shafts connect the fans and blades. Supports keep them lined up.
turbofan.nozzle: This shaped outlet guides fast gas out of the back of the engine.
turbofan.control: Sensors and controls help manage the engine. Other equipment helps it start and stay oiled.

spacecraft-aocs.bus: The main frame holds the spacecraft's equipment in the right positions.
spacecraft-aocs.wheels: Speeding up or slowing down these wheels helps turn the spacecraft the other way.
spacecraft-aocs.computer: The computer checks where the spacecraft is pointing and asks other parts to correct it.
spacecraft-aocs.thrusters: These small engines push gas out to change how the spacecraft moves.
spacecraft-aocs.tracker: This camera recognises star patterns to work out which way the spacecraft is pointing.
spacecraft-aocs.gyro: These sensors measure how quickly the spacecraft is turning.
spacecraft-aocs.sun: These sensors measure the direction of sunlight to help work out where the spacecraft is pointing.
spacecraft-aocs.torquers: These electrical coils act like magnets. They can help turn a spacecraft where a planet's magnetic field is strong enough.
spacecraft-aocs.propellant: Tanks and pipes store and carry the material used by the small engines.
spacecraft-aocs.arrays: These panels turn sunlight into electricity for the spacecraft's equipment.

nuclear-submarine.hull: The outer structure and supports hold the machinery steady and lined up.
nuclear-submarine.reactor: Splitting atoms inside this sealed unit releases heat. This model shows only its role as a heat source.
nuclear-submarine.steam-generator: Heat passes from one water system to a separate one, making steam without mixing the two.
nuclear-submarine.turbine: Moving steam pushes these blades and makes them turn.
nuclear-submarine.condenser: Cooling turns used steam back into water so it can be used again.
nuclear-submarine.pumps: Pumps keep water moving through the separate paths.
nuclear-submarine.shaft: This turning connection carries movement from the machinery towards the propeller.
nuclear-submarine.propulsor: This part pushes water backwards to help move the submarine forwards.
nuclear-submarine.generator: This machine uses turning movement to make electricity for equipment on board.
nuclear-submarine.monitoring: Sensors help operators check the machinery and spot unusual conditions.

drone-swarm.platform: This shared area is where the drones carry out tasks such as taking pictures.
drone-swarm.airframes: Each drone needs its own body, motors and moving parts.
drone-swarm.controllers: Each drone has its own computer to help control its movement.
drone-swarm.coordination: A shared plan helps the drones divide the work and avoid conflicting actions.
drone-swarm.radios: Radio messages let drones share what they are doing. Messages can arrive late or go missing.
drone-swarm.localisation: Drones need ways to estimate where they are and where other drones are.
drone-swarm.payloads: Cameras or other measuring tools collect information for the task.
drone-swarm.charging: Batteries limit how long each drone can work before charging.
drone-swarm.supervision: This screen helps a person follow the work and check the drones.
drone-swarm.separation: This checking system watches how far apart drones are and allows for errors in their position estimates.

smart-grid.site: Supports hold wires and other electricity equipment in place.
smart-grid.generation: Power sources supply electricity to the network.
smart-grid.transformer: This device changes the electrical push, called voltage, to suit different parts of the network.
smart-grid.demand: Homes, schools and machines use electricity from the network.
smart-grid.storage: Stored energy can be saved for a time when it is needed.
smart-grid.breakers: Large switches can connect or disconnect parts of the electricity network.
smart-grid.meters: Meters measure how electricity is being supplied and used.
smart-grid.communications: Messages carry measurements and instructions between parts of the network.
smart-grid.control: A control system uses measurements to help manage the electricity network.
smart-grid.inverters: These devices change electricity from some batteries and generators into the kind the network uses.

microprocessor.package: This outer package protects the tiny chip and connects it to a larger circuit board.
microprocessor.cores: These working areas follow the instructions in a program, one task after another.
microprocessor.gpu: Many working areas can do similar calculations at the same time, which helps create images.
microprocessor.cache: Small nearby stores keep information that the chip is likely to need again soon.
microprocessor.registers: These very small stores keep the numbers the chip is working on right now.
microprocessor.interconnect: These connections carry information between the chip's working areas.
microprocessor.memory: This part organises the movement of information between the chip and its main memory.
microprocessor.clock: A repeating electrical beat helps the chip's working areas act at the right times.
microprocessor.power: Electrical connections supply energy to the chip's tiny switches.
microprocessor.cooling: A cooling path carries heat away so the chip can keep working within its limits.

mri.frame: This large frame holds the magnet and the opening where the person is positioned.
mri.magnet: A strong magnet helps prepare the body to give off signals that the machine can measure.
mri.gradients: Extra magnets make the magnetic field vary across the body, helping locate where signals come from.
mri.table: This table moves the person into the area being scanned.
mri.rf: Radio waves help produce signals from the body, and coils pick those signals up.
mri.receiver: Electronics prepare the weak signals so the computer can use them.
mri.cryostat: Some magnets need to be kept extremely cold to work properly.
mri.shim: These adjustments make the magnetic field more even where the image is taken.
mri.reconstruction: A computer uses the measured signals to build an image of the inside of the body.
mri.amplifiers: Powerful electronics supply the changing electrical signals needed by the magnets and coils.

autonomous-driving.vehicle: The car still needs real steering, brakes and powered wheels to move.
autonomous-driving.cameras: Cameras capture pictures of the road and nearby objects.
autonomous-driving.compute: Computers use measurements to estimate what is happening and request driving actions.
autonomous-driving.actuators: Motors and other moving parts carry out requests to steer, brake or drive.
autonomous-driving.lidar: This sensor uses light to help measure distances to nearby objects.
autonomous-driving.radar: This sensor uses radio waves to help detect objects and their movement.
autonomous-driving.localisation: The car combines clues to estimate where it is and how it is moving.
autonomous-driving.perception: Software turns sensor readings into useful descriptions of the surroundings.
autonomous-driving.planning: Software considers what might happen next and chooses a possible driving path.
autonomous-driving.monitor: A checking system looks for problems in the sensors, computers and controls.

suspension-bridge.foundations: The foundations carry the bridge's weight into the ground. Strong end supports hold the main cables.
suspension-bridge.towers: The tall towers hold up the main cables and carry forces down to the ground.
suspension-bridge.deck: This is the roadway. It passes the weight of traffic to the supporting parts.
suspension-bridge.cables: Thick cables carry pulling forces. Smaller hanging cables join them to the roadway.
suspension-bridge.isolators: These supports allow controlled movement, helping reduce the shaking passed between parts.
suspension-bridge.dampers: These devices take energy out of unwanted movement, helping shaking die down.
suspension-bridge.joints: Small gaps allow parts of the bridge to move as it warms, cools or shakes.
suspension-bridge.monitoring: Sensors measure movement and other changes in the bridge.
suspension-bridge.bearings: These seats hold the supports between the roadway and the structure below.
suspension-bridge.connections: Strong connections join the bridge parts and pass forces between them.

wastewater.site: Tanks and supports hold the water as it moves through cleaning stages.
wastewater.screening: Screens catch large rubbish, and another stage removes heavy grit.
wastewater.primary: In a quiet tank, some solid material sinks to the bottom.
wastewater.aeration: Tiny living things help break down some waste in the water.
wastewater.clarifier: Another settling tank separates tiny living things and other solids from the water.
wastewater.return: Some settled material is sent back to keep enough helpful living things in the system.
wastewater.disinfection: This stage reduces harmful tiny living things in the water.
wastewater.sludge: Collected solid waste goes through a separate treatment path.
wastewater.blowers: Air pumps send air to the parts of the system that need it.
wastewater.sensors: Sensors help workers check how the treatment is going.

high-speed-rail.track: The rails guide the train's wheels and carry their weight.
high-speed-rail.carbody: The train body carries people and equipment and holds the whole vehicle together.
high-speed-rail.bogies: These frames underneath the train hold the wheels and spring supports.
high-speed-rail.traction: Electrical equipment controls the motors that turn the train's wheels.
high-speed-rail.pantograph: This moving arm keeps contact with the overhead electricity wire.
high-speed-rail.transformer: This device changes the electrical push, called voltage, before the train uses it.
high-speed-rail.brakes: Brakes slow the train. Some can turn movement back into electrical energy.
high-speed-rail.suspension: Springs and other supports soften movement between the wheels and the train body.
high-speed-rail.control: Control equipment coordinates the train's systems and checks how they are working.
high-speed-rail.signalling: Signals tell the train when and where it is allowed to move.

skyscraper-hvac.structure: Spaces between floors hold equipment and the paths for air and water.
skyscraper-hvac.chiller: This machine cools water by moving its heat somewhere else.
skyscraper-hvac.air-handler: This unit moves air and can filter it or change its temperature.
skyscraper-hvac.risers: Vertical pipes and passages carry water or air between floors.
skyscraper-hvac.zones: Equipment near a room delivers air or helps change its temperature.
skyscraper-hvac.pumps: Pumps move water around the building's heating or cooling pipes.
skyscraper-hvac.dampers: Small moving gates change how much air or water can pass.
skyscraper-hvac.sensors: Sensors measure conditions such as room temperature.
skyscraper-hvac.automation: A control system compares room conditions with the chosen settings and adjusts equipment.
skyscraper-hvac.rejection: The heat removed from the building must eventually go out into the surroundings.

fluid-catalytic-cracking.site: Large supports hold the tanks, pipes and other equipment.
fluid-catalytic-cracking.riser: Oil meets hot particles that help break large oil molecules into smaller ones.
fluid-catalytic-cracking.reactor: This area separates useful gases from the circulating solid particles.
fluid-catalytic-cracking.regenerator: This area removes built-up material so the particles can be used again.
fluid-catalytic-cracking.cyclones: Spinning gas paths help separate solid particles from the gas.
fluid-catalytic-cracking.circulation: Pipes carry the particles between the two main processing areas.
fluid-catalytic-cracking.fractionator: This tall unit separates products into groups with different boiling temperatures.
fluid-catalytic-cracking.air: An air supply serves the area that cleans the circulating particles.
fluid-catalytic-cracking.exchangers: These units pass heat from one stream to another without mixing them.
fluid-catalytic-cracking.instrumentation: Measuring and protection systems help workers check conditions around the plant.

hemodialysis.cabinet: The outer cabinet holds the machine's separate parts and connections.
hemodialysis.pump: A pump moves blood through a path outside the body during treatment.
hemodialysis.dialyzer: A very thin separating layer lets some waste move out of the blood while keeping the two liquid paths separate.
hemodialysis.dialysate: A special cleaning liquid flows on the other side of the separating layer.
hemodialysis.pressure: Sensors measure how strongly liquid is pushing at different points.
hemodialysis.air-detector: A detector checks for air in the blood-carrying path.
hemodialysis.clamp: This closing part can stop flow through a tube when required.
hemodialysis.water: Carefully prepared water is needed to make the cleaning liquid.
hemodialysis.controller: Electronics coordinate the machine and check its measurements.
hemodialysis.interfaces: Separate connections keep the different liquid paths connected to the right places.

bioreactor.vessel: This container holds the liquid where living cells grow or carry out useful work.
bioreactor.stirrer: A rotating mixer moves the liquid around.
bioreactor.jacket: A separate outer space carries heating or cooling liquid around the container.
bioreactor.controller: A computer checks measurements against chosen settings and adjusts equipment.
bioreactor.sparger: Small openings send gas into the liquid.
bioreactor.probes: Sensors measure conditions at the places where they touch the process.
bioreactor.feed: A supply path brings new material into the container.
bioreactor.filters: Filters help control what can pass into or out of connected paths.
bioreactor.exhaust: An outlet allows gas to leave the container.
bioreactor.sampling: A sampling point lets workers take a small amount to check what is happening inside.

desalination.site: Supports hold the tanks, pipes and other equipment in place.
desalination.pretreatment: The incoming seawater is prepared before it reaches the main separating stage.
desalination.pump: A strong pump pushes water towards the separating layers.
desalination.membranes: Very thin layers let much of the water through while holding back much of the salt.
desalination.permeate: The water that passes through is collected separately.
desalination.brine: The saltier water left behind follows a different path.
desalination.recovery: This device uses some of the energy in the outgoing salty water to help the incoming flow.
desalination.monitoring: Sensors help workers check the water at different stages.
desalination.posttreatment: Further treatment prepares the collected water for its intended use.
desalination.controls: Controls coordinate the pumps and the other stages of the process.

factory-line.frame: The frame holds each work station in the right place.
factory-line.conveyor: A moving belt or similar system carries items between work stations.
factory-line.robot: A robot moves a tool along a planned path to work on an item.
factory-line.fixture: A holder keeps the item steady and correctly placed while work happens.
factory-line.gripper: A gripping tool picks up or holds an item.
factory-line.sensors: Sensors check where items are and what the machines are doing.
factory-line.plc: A computer decides which machine action should happen next.
factory-line.inspection: A checking station looks for differences between the item and the required result.
factory-line.safety: Protection systems can stop unsafe actions separately from the normal production sequence.
factory-line.outfeed: This path carries completed items away from the line.

euv-lithography.frame: A very steady frame helps the tiny moving parts stay accurately lined up.
euv-lithography.source: A laser hits tiny pieces of tin to make light with an extremely short wavelength.
euv-lithography.collector: A shaped mirror collects some of that light and sends it onwards.
euv-lithography.wafer: A thin round slice of material receives the tiny circuit pattern.
euv-lithography.illuminator: This equipment prepares the light before it reaches the pattern.
euv-lithography.reticle: This plate carries the pattern to be copied onto the thin slice.
euv-lithography.projection: Special mirrors guide and shrink the pattern onto the surface below.
euv-lithography.vacuum: Air is removed from this space because it would absorb this special light.
euv-lithography.metrology: Measuring systems check the positions of parts that must line up extremely precisely.
euv-lithography.handling: A handling system moves the thin slices between protected spaces.

gas-turbine-plant.site: Strong supports hold the power plant's machines in line.
gas-turbine-plant.combustor: Fuel burns with the squeezed air and makes the gas hotter.
gas-turbine-plant.turbine: Hot gas turns blades on a shaft.
gas-turbine-plant.generator: The turning shaft drives a machine that makes electricity.
gas-turbine-plant.hrsg: Hot exhaust can be used to make steam instead of letting all its heat escape.
gas-turbine-plant.steam: That steam can drive another machine to make extra electricity.
gas-turbine-plant.exhaust: The remaining exhaust gas leaves through this path.
gas-turbine-plant.cooling: Cooling systems carry away heat that cannot be turned into useful work.
gas-turbine-plant.controls: Sensors and controls check the plant and coordinate its equipment.

refrigerator.cabinet: Thick walls slow down heat coming in from the room.
refrigerator.compressor: This pump squeezes and moves a special cooling fluid around a sealed loop.
refrigerator.condenser: These pipes release heat from the cooling fluid into the room.
refrigerator.evaporator: The cooling fluid takes heat from the fridge at these pipes.
refrigerator.expansion: A narrow opening lowers the fluid's pressure before it takes in heat.
refrigerator.fan: A fan moves air across the cooling parts and around the fridge.
refrigerator.controller: A controller checks the temperature and decides when cooling is needed.
refrigerator.defrost: A clearing cycle removes ice that could block air and slow cooling.
refrigerator.door: A soft seal around the door helps keep warm air out.
refrigerator.sensors: Sensors check temperature. Different places inside the fridge can have different temperatures.

inverter-ac.frames: One unit handles room air and another releases heat outdoors.
inverter-ac.compressor: An adjustable motor drives the pump that moves the cooling fluid.
inverter-ac.indoor-coil: In cooling mode, these indoor pipes take heat from the room air.
inverter-ac.outdoor-coil: These outdoor pipes release the room's heat and the extra heat from running the pump.
inverter-ac.expansion: An opening lowers the cooling fluid's pressure before it takes in room heat.
inverter-ac.indoor-fan: This long fan moves room air across the indoor cooling pipes.
inverter-ac.outdoor-fan: This fan moves outside air over the outdoor pipes.
inverter-ac.inverter: Electronics adjust the power sent to the pump's motor.
inverter-ac.sensing: Sensors measure temperature at different places in the system.
inverter-ac.drain: Water collected from damp room air leaves through a drain.

microwave.cavity: The metal cooking space keeps the microwave energy around the food.
microwave.source: This part changes electrical energy into the microwave energy used for heating.
microwave.waveguide: A metal passage guides microwave energy into the cooking space.
microwave.turntable: The turning plate moves food through different parts of the heating pattern.
microwave.inverter: Electronics control the power supplied to the microwave source.
microwave.fan: A fan carries heat away from electrical parts.
microwave.door: The door's metal features help keep microwave energy inside while letting you see the food.
microwave.interlocks: Door switches prevent normal cooking when the door is open.
microwave.controller: The controller manages the chosen cooking time and power.
microwave.sensors: Sensors check heat in parts of the oven to help protect them.

robot-vacuum.chassis: The body holds the wheels, cleaning parts and sensors.
robot-vacuum.brush: A turning brush loosens dirt and moves it towards the suction opening.
robot-vacuum.fan: A fan creates moving air that carries dust into the cleaner.
robot-vacuum.bin: This container separates and collects dirt from the moving air.
robot-vacuum.wheels: Separate powered wheels let the robot turn and move.
robot-vacuum.battery: The battery stores energy for cleaning and movement.
robot-vacuum.controller: A computer uses sensor readings to choose where the cleaner goes.
robot-vacuum.vision: A small camera or similar light sensor observes the area around the robot.
robot-vacuum.edge: Sensors look down and nearby to help detect drops and obstacles.
robot-vacuum.dock: The robot lines itself up with this station so its battery can recharge.

washing-machine.frame: The outer body holds the washing machine's heavy and moving parts.
washing-machine.drum: This turning container holds the clothes while water passes through its holes.
washing-machine.tub: This outer container holds water around the turning drum.
washing-machine.motor: A motor turns the drum during washing and spinning.
washing-machine.suspension: Springs and supports reduce the shaking passed to the outer body.
washing-machine.dispenser: Incoming water carries washing liquid or powder into the washing space.
washing-machine.door: A flexible seal keeps water in, and a lock controls when the door can open.
washing-machine.controller: A controller runs the steps of the chosen wash programme.
washing-machine.sensing: Sensors check water level, turning speed and uneven shaking.

wireless-earbuds.shell: The small outer shells hold the parts and sit near your ears.
wireless-earbuds.radio: A radio receives sound information from your phone. Electronics turn it into a signal for the sound-making part.
wireless-earbuds.driver: Electrical flow in a tiny wire coil makes a thin surface move. It pushes air to create sound.
wireless-earbuds.battery: A small rechargeable battery powers each earbud.
wireless-earbuds.microphones: Tiny microphones pick up your voice and surrounding sound.
wireless-earbuds.antenna: This small part sends and receives radio signals through the air.
wireless-earbuds.controls: Sensors notice whether you are wearing the earbuds or deliberately pressing a control.
wireless-earbuds.case: The case holds the earbuds and stores energy to recharge them.
wireless-earbuds.charging: Protective charging electronics manage how energy reaches the case and earbud batteries.
wireless-earbuds.acoustics: Small openings, spaces and mesh affect how air and sound move inside the earbud.

induction-cooktop.frame: The frame holds the electrical parts below the cooking surface.
induction-cooktop.coil: A changing electrical flow in this coil creates a changing magnetic field.
induction-cooktop.pan: A suitable pan receives energy from the magnetic field and gets hot.
induction-cooktop.glass: This tough surface holds the pan above the internal parts.
induction-cooktop.inverter: Electronics create the rapidly changing electrical flow needed by the coil.
induction-cooktop.ferrite: These pieces help guide the magnetic field below the coil.
induction-cooktop.fan: A fan carries heat away from the electronics.
induction-cooktop.sensors: Sensors help check for a suitable pan and monitor the equipment.
induction-cooktop.controller: A controller turns your chosen setting into the requested heating action.
induction-cooktop.filter: Electrical filters reduce unwanted electrical signals passing into or out of the cooker.

home-console.chassis: The case holds the circuit boards, cooling parts and sockets in place.
home-console.processor: The main chip follows game instructions and does many image calculations at once.
home-console.memory: Fast memory holds information the game is using right now.
home-console.storage: Longer-term storage keeps installed games even when the power is off.
home-console.cooling: Heat passes from the main chip into parts that can release it.
home-console.fan: A fan moves air through the cooling parts.
home-console.power: The power supply changes incoming electricity into what the different parts need.
home-console.io: Sockets carry pictures, network messages and accessory information.
home-console.radio: Radio links carry messages from wireless controllers or networks.
home-console.controller: Management electronics coordinate starting, power use and checks.

smart-watch.case: The case protects a small computer. The strap holds it near your wrist.
smart-watch.display: The screen shows information, and a separate sensing layer notices touch.
smart-watch.processor: A small chip runs apps and coordinates sensors and wireless messages.
smart-watch.battery: A small rechargeable battery powers the watch.
smart-watch.optical: Small lights shine on the skin and a sensor measures how much light comes back.
smart-watch.imu: Motion sensors notice changes in movement and turning.
smart-watch.radio: A radio exchanges information with nearby devices or networks.
smart-watch.haptics: A small moving weight makes vibrations you can feel.
smart-watch.charging: A charging connection transfers energy into the battery through protective electronics.
smart-watch.controls: Buttons and a turning knob let you send instructions to the watch.

laser-printer.frame: The frame lines up the paper path and the parts that create the image.
laser-printer.feed: Rollers pick up a sheet and move it through the printer.
laser-printer.drum: A special surface holds an electrical pattern for the page.
laser-printer.laser: A moving light beam draws the page pattern on the special surface.
laser-printer.toner: Fine coloured powder is brought to the areas that form the image.
laser-printer.transfer: Electrical forces move the powder image onto the paper.
laser-printer.fuser: Heat and pressure fix the powder to the paper.
laser-printer.cleaning: A cleaning part removes leftover powder before the next page.
laser-printer.controller: The controller turns page information into timed light and paper movements.
laser-printer.sensors: Sensors check the paper's position and the heat in the fixing part.

coffee-barista.frame: The frame holds the parts that carry coffee beans, water and the drink.
coffee-barista.hopper: This container feeds beans down into the grinder.
coffee-barista.grinder: Moving grinding surfaces break beans into small pieces.
coffee-barista.brewer: This holder keeps ground coffee in place as water passes through it.
coffee-barista.reservoir: A tank stores water before use.
coffee-barista.pump: A pump pushes water through the machine.
coffee-barista.heater: An electrical heater warms water as it passes.
coffee-barista.valves: Small gates choose which water path is open.
coffee-barista.outlet: A spout guides coffee into your cup. A tray catches drips.
coffee-barista.controller: A controller coordinates grinding, pumping, heating and brewing.

dslr-camera.body: The body holds the lens at the right distance from the light sensor.
dslr-camera.lens: Shaped clear pieces focus light. An adjustable opening controls how much light enters.
dslr-camera.mirror: This mirror sends light towards the viewing window before a photo is taken.
dslr-camera.sensor: A sensor changes arriving light into electrical signals.
dslr-camera.shutter: A moving cover controls how long light reaches the sensor.
dslr-camera.viewfinder: This clear block or mirror arrangement lets you see through the lens.
dslr-camera.processor: A chip turns sensor readings into image information.
dslr-camera.battery: A battery supplies the energy to move parts and process pictures.
dslr-camera.storage: A memory card keeps pictures after the power is turned off.
dslr-camera.controls: Buttons and dials let you choose settings. The screen shows images and information.

optical-mouse.base: The base keeps the tiny camera close to the desk surface.
optical-mouse.illumination: A small light makes the surface easier for the sensor to see.
optical-mouse.lens: A tiny lens makes an image of the surface below.
optical-mouse.sensor: The sensor compares surface images to estimate how far the mouse has moved.
optical-mouse.switches: Pressing a button changes an electrical connection.
optical-mouse.wheel: Turning the wheel creates signals for scrolling.
optical-mouse.controller: A chip combines movement, button presses and scrolling into messages.
optical-mouse.radio: A radio sends messages to the computer in this wireless example.
optical-mouse.battery: A battery powers the sensor and wireless link.
optical-mouse.shell: The outer shell supports your hand and passes your presses to the buttons.

insulin-pump.case: The case protects the delivery parts and electronics.
insulin-pump.reservoir: A small container holds insulin before delivery.
insulin-pump.actuator: A moving mechanism helps push liquid from the container in this example.
insulin-pump.controller: A computer coordinates the device's functions and receives input.
insulin-pump.battery: A battery powers the computer, wireless link and moving parts.
insulin-pump.display: The screen shows information and lets a person enter instructions.
insulin-pump.sensing: Sensors help detect problems in the delivery path.
insulin-pump.radio: Some connected pumps receive readings from a separate glucose sensor.
insulin-pump.outlet: A protected outlet joins the device to its delivery tubing or other external connection.
insulin-pump.monitor: A checking system monitors conditions and reports the device's status.

electric-toothbrush.handle: The handle holds the battery, moving mechanism and controls.
electric-toothbrush.battery: A rechargeable battery powers the brush.
electric-toothbrush.drive: Electrical and magnetic forces create movement inside the handle.
electric-toothbrush.head: The bristles pass the brush's movement to the surfaces they touch.
electric-toothbrush.shaft: A small shaft carries movement from the internal mechanism to the brush head.
electric-toothbrush.controller: A controller manages the selected brushing action and timing.
electric-toothbrush.pressure: A support holds the moving shaft in place while letting it move.
electric-toothbrush.charging: The charging stand sends energy through a magnetic field to recharge the battery.
electric-toothbrush.button: A sealed button lets you start, stop or change the brushing action.
electric-toothbrush.seals: Seals help protect the handle where the moving shaft leaves it.

wtc-bathtub.bedrock: Strong rock below the site helps support the foundations.
wtc-bathtub.slurry-wall: Deep walls hold back soil and reduce water entering the basement.
wtc-bathtub.raft: This base connects the structures inside the enclosing walls.
wtc-bathtub.anchors: Strong anchors help keep the walls from moving inwards during construction.
wtc-bathtub.cages: Steel bars inside concrete help it resist bending.
wtc-bathtub.joints: These connections join neighbouring wall sections.
wtc-bathtub.columns: Columns pass the building's weight down towards strong ground.
wtc-bathtub.liner: This layer shows added strengthening of the enclosing structure.
wtc-bathtub.drainage: Drains manage water that reaches the basement.
wtc-bathtub.monitoring: Sensors check movement and water conditions over time.
wtc-bathtub.groundwater: This surrounding water pushes against the outside of the wall.
wtc-bathtub.penetrations: These openings show where services pass through the enclosing wall.

channel-tunnel.ground: The surrounding ground holds up and presses on the tunnel walls.
channel-tunnel.rail-bores: Two separate tunnels each carry trains on one track.
channel-tunnel.service-bore: A smaller middle tunnel provides space for maintenance and escape.
channel-tunnel.track: Rails hold up and guide the train wheels.
channel-tunnel.cross-passages: Short passages connect the train tunnels to the middle tunnel.
channel-tunnel.doors: Doors separate spaces and help control what can pass between them.
channel-tunnel.catenary: Overhead wires supply electricity to the trains.
channel-tunnel.walkways: Walkways provide routes for workers and people leaving a train.
channel-tunnel.cooling: Pipes carry heat away to cooling equipment.
channel-tunnel.ventilation: Fans and passages control air movement and pressure.
channel-tunnel.drainage: Drains collect water and pumps move it away from low points.
channel-tunnel.signals: Signals coordinate trains, while sensors check the tunnel's condition.

golden-gate-bearings.pier: The support below carries forces towards the ground.
golden-gate-bearings.rubber: Rubber layers let the support move sideways in a controlled way.
golden-gate-bearings.steel: Thin steel layers stop the rubber from bulging too much.
golden-gate-bearings.deck: The roadway passes weight onto the support below.
golden-gate-bearings.core: This optional central part shows one way to take energy out of shaking.
golden-gate-bearings.upper-plate: The top plate connects the support to the structure above.
golden-gate-bearings.lower-plate: The bottom plate connects the support to its seat.
golden-gate-bearings.anchors: Strong bolts keep the connections in place.
golden-gate-bearings.seat: This firm surface holds the support.
golden-gate-bearings.restraint: This part shows how movement can be allowed in some directions and limited in others.
golden-gate-bearings.monitor: Sensors record how the structure moves.
golden-gate-bearings.cover: A cover protects the accessible parts of the support.

raptor-1.mount: This mount passes the engine's pushing force to the rocket.
raptor-1.chamber: Fuel and oxygen-rich gases meet here and burn to make very hot gas.
raptor-1.nozzle: This shaped outlet sends hot gas backwards quickly to push the rocket forwards.
raptor-1.fuel-pump: This pump pushes liquid fuel to a higher pressure.
raptor-1.oxygen-pump: This pump pushes liquid oxygen to a higher pressure.
raptor-1.fuel-preburner: This small burning chamber makes fuel-rich hot gas that turns the fuel pump's driving wheel.
raptor-1.oxygen-preburner: This small burning chamber makes oxygen-rich hot gas that turns the oxygen pump's driving wheel.
raptor-1.injector: This plate spreads the incoming gases through many small openings.
raptor-1.throat: This narrow part sits between the burning chamber and the wider outlet.
raptor-1.fuel-turbine: Hot gas turns this bladed wheel to drive the fuel pump.
raptor-1.oxygen-turbine: Hot gas turns this bladed wheel to drive the oxygen pump.
raptor-1.fuel-inducer: This part helps feed liquid smoothly towards the fuel pump.
raptor-1.oxygen-inducer: This part helps feed liquid smoothly towards the oxygen pump.
raptor-1.fuel-inlet: This connection brings fuel from the rocket into the engine.
raptor-1.oxygen-inlet: This connection brings liquid oxygen into the engine.
raptor-1.fuel-valve: This moving gate changes the path available for fuel.
raptor-1.oxygen-valve: This moving gate changes the path available for oxygen.
raptor-1.fuel-manifold: These passages share fuel between the paths that need it.
raptor-1.oxygen-manifold: These passages share oxygen between the paths that need it.
raptor-1.fuel-duct: This pipe carries fuel-side gas towards the main burning chamber.
raptor-1.oxygen-duct: This pipe carries oxygen-side gas towards the main burning chamber.
raptor-1.cooling-jacket: A cooling path takes heat from the hot chamber wall.
raptor-1.ignition: These parts help start the burning process in a controlled way.
raptor-1.gimbal: This joint lets a steerable engine tilt to change the direction of its push.
raptor-1.actuators: These moving parts push on the mount to tilt the engine.
raptor-1.pressure: Sensors measure how strongly liquids or gases push inside selected paths.
raptor-1.temperature: Sensors measure how hot different parts are.
raptor-1.controller: A computer checks measurements and coordinates requested actions.
raptor-1.harness: These wires carry electrical messages between the engine's parts.
raptor-1.retainers: Fasteners hold the separate engine parts together.

burj-foundation.ground: The surrounding ground forms part of the building's support.
burj-foundation.piles: Long supports deep in the ground pass weight into it through their sides and ends.
burj-foundation.raft: A thick concrete base shares the building's weight across the deep supports and ground.
burj-foundation.core: The central structure and columns push the building's weight onto the base.
burj-foundation.cages: Steel bars inside the deep concrete supports help strengthen them.
burj-foundation.heads: These connections join the deep supports to the thick base.
burj-foundation.upper-steel: Steel near the top helps the concrete base resist bending.
burj-foundation.lower-steel: Steel near the bottom also helps the concrete base resist bending.
burj-foundation.waterproofing: Protective layers help control water entering the structure.
burj-foundation.joints: These joins mark where separate construction stages meet.
burj-foundation.monitoring: Sensors measure movement and other changes over time.
burj-foundation.formation: This layer shows the difference between deep support and the ground near the surface.

hoover-galleries.foundation: The rock below supports the dam and receives forces from it.
hoover-galleries.concrete: Large concrete blocks pass the water's push into the canyon sides and ground.
hoover-galleries.gallery: Passages inside the dam give workers access to check it.
hoover-galleries.drains: Small drains guide water that has seeped into the dam towards checking points.
hoover-galleries.grout: Material placed in rock gaps helps reduce paths for leaking water.
hoover-galleries.joints: Joins separate the concrete blocks while keeping the intended connections.
hoover-galleries.waterstops: Water-blocking strips reduce water crossing selected joins.
hoover-galleries.collection: This path collects seeped water so it can be measured and drained.
hoover-galleries.instruments: Instruments measure changes in the dam and the ground below.
hoover-galleries.access: This route shows the working space inside the passage.
hoover-galleries.services: Small service systems support checking and measuring.
hoover-galleries.upstream: The water beside the dam shows where the main water force comes from.

lagos-revetment.formation: The ground below holds up the sea-protection layers.
lagos-revetment.armour: Large outer blocks take the force of waves and protect the slope.
lagos-revetment.core: The inner body holds the slope's shape.
lagos-revetment.filter: This layer lets water move through while helping stop smaller material washing away.
lagos-revetment.underlayer: This layer supports the large outer blocks and spreads their weight.
lagos-revetment.toe: A strong lower edge helps hold the bottom blocks in place.
lagos-revetment.crest: The top edge forms the boundary towards the protected land.
lagos-revetment.backfill: This filled ground lies behind the sea-protection structure.
lagos-revetment.drainage: A separate drain path manages collected water.
lagos-revetment.joints: These joins show where neighbouring materials meet.
lagos-revetment.survey: Measurements check the structure's shape and movement over time.
lagos-revetment.water: The water shows the waves acting on the protective layers.

third-mainland-joints.pier: The bridge support carries forces down towards the ground.
third-mainland-joints.joint: A gap lets neighbouring roadway sections move slightly as conditions change.
third-mainland-joints.bearing: A support passes weight down while allowing its intended movement.
third-mainland-joints.deck: The roadway sections bring traffic weight to the support.
third-mainland-joints.edge-beams: Strong edges hold the road surfaces beside the gap.
third-mainland-joints.seals: Flexible seals help manage water and dirt at the moving gap.
third-mainland-joints.anchors: Anchors join the edge parts to the bridge.
third-mainland-joints.plates: Plates spread forces where the support meets the bridge.
third-mainland-joints.seat: This firm surface holds the support in place.
third-mainland-joints.drainage: Drains collect water reaching the roadway gap.
third-mainland-joints.restraint: This part shows which movements are allowed and which are held back.
third-mainland-joints.monitor: Checks track the gap's position and the condition of the supports.

headphones.headband: A curved band holds the two earcups over your ears.
headphones.yokes: Small jointed supports connect each earcup to the headband.
headphones.cups: The outer cups protect the sound-making parts and electronics.
headphones.cushions: Soft rings fit around your ears and help keep sound from leaking.
headphones.drivers: Thin moving surfaces push air to make sound.
headphones.magnets: Magnets provide the magnetic field used by the sound-making mechanism.
headphones.coils: Electrical flow through a small wire coil makes it move in the magnetic field.
headphones.radio: Electronics receive wireless sound information and send a signal to the sound-making parts.
headphones.battery: A rechargeable battery powers the electronics.
headphones.microphones: Microphones pick up speech and outside sound for calls or noise control.
headphones.controls: Buttons or touch areas let you choose what the headphones do.
headphones.charging: A charging connection and protective electronics recharge the battery.
